scripts.dev:db: npm run compose -- up -d core-db user-db auth-db
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=apps/breezy-web && npm run build --workspace=apps/breezy-api
scripts.lint: npm run lint:npm && npm run lint:go
scripts.docs:web: mkdir -p docs/web && typedoc --tsconfig apps/breezy-web/tsconfig.app.json --entryPointStrategy resolve --entryPoints apps/breezy-web/src/main.tsx --customCss docs-assets/typedoc-custom.css --out docs/web
scripts.build:docs: npm run docs:api && npm run docs:web && npm run docs:home
